# EotG cyberware (body rig) customization lists, from items: actuator_leg, chest_housing, corp_badge, crew_collar, fitter_harness, limb_frame, scorched_actuator, spinal_housing, wrist_servo. Generated by ck3_cyberware.py regen; do not hand-edit.
# Race-specific variants (bull head, small/large/heavy frame, elf/orc/goblin/Chad Orc ears, tusks) are left out;
# RACE_VARIANT_TOKENS / RACE_GATES in scripts/ck3_cyberware.py list them again behind a race trigger.

eotg_custom_cyber_spine = {
	usage = customization
	interface_position = 30

	add_accessory_modifiers = {
		gene = eotg_cyber_spine
		template = eotg_cyber_spine_none
	}

	add_accessory_modifiers = {
		gene = eotg_cyber_spine

		is_valid_custom = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { exists = root }
				is_adult = yes
			}
		}
